# SunoSathi (सुनोसाथी)

> SunoSathi turns a deaf or hard-of-hearing person's OWN mobile number into
> a captioned phone. They forward their existing number once (dial code
> **21*…#); calls then ring in the SunoSathi app, where they read the
> caller's words as live subtitles — Hindi, Gujarati, English or Hinglish,
> auto-detected — and reply with their voice, by typing (the caller hears
> it spoken in a natural voice), or by tapping picture tiles that speak
> whole sentences. The caller needs no app: they dial the normal number
> they already know and talk normally.

## Key facts
- Audience: 63 million deaf and hard-of-hearing Indians, including
  non-speaking and sign-language-first users
- Users keep their existing phone number — one-time carrier call
  forwarding, no new SIM, no porting, nothing for callers to change
- Languages: Hindi, Gujarati, English, Hinglish (auto-detected per
  utterance); unidentifiable speech is captioned phonetically; captions
  always render in readable Devanagari/Gujarati/Latin script
- Captions arrive in under a second at natural speech pauses
- Reply three ways: own voice · type-to-speak (typed text spoken to the
  caller ~1s later, choice of male/female Indian voices) · picture-talk
  board (tap a tile, a full sentence is spoken — no literacy needed)
- While the user types, the caller automatically hears "please wait a
  moment" so they stay on the line
- Calls ring with continuous vibration and lock-screen alerts even with
  the app closed and screen off (Android app)
- Outbound captioned calls to any number
- Every call saved as transcript + audio; caption accuracy automatically
  re-checked and scored per call (typically 81–95% on natural speech)
- Adaptive noise gating: background noise is filtered before speech
  recognition so ambient sound never becomes junk captions
- Microphone optional: calls can be answered with no mic at all
- Speech-to-text: Sarvam AI (saaras v3); TTS: Sarvam Bulbul; pluggable
  providers (Deepgram, Google, ElevenLabs)
- Status: free public pilot (2026); join at https://sunosathi.com/#pilot
- Built at the GrowthX buildathon; born from a LinkedIn build-in-public post
